item.title: Swedish children and teens face gambling problems
item.description: An increasing number of Swedish children and teenagers are suffering from gambling addiction, often linked to gaming, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: SOCAR wins European Commission approval for Italian takeover
item.description: Brussels is prepared to embrace new actors in Europe’s energy market as the European Commission has given the green light for Azerbaijan’s state energy giant SOCAR to acquire Italiana Petroli, one of Italy’s largest integrated downstream energy platforms. The approval covers a 99.82% stake in the company, in a deal first signed in September 2025 but only recently cleared by EU regulators as having no competitive concerns.

item.title: Expert warns of AI replacing workers
item.description: Companies attempting to replace young professionals with artificial intelligence (AI) risk facing a serious talent shortage in the coming years, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Ethiopia’s PM visits grave of National Leader Heydar Aliyev at Alley of Honor
item.description: On February 27, Prime Minister of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Abiy Ahmed, who is on an official visit to Azerbaijan, paid tribute to Azerbaijan’s National Leader and architect of the country’s modern independent state, Heydar Aliyev, by visiting his grave at the Alley of Honor in Baku.

item.title: Ethiopia’s PM visits Victory Park
item.description: A delegation led by Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed visited Victory Park in Baku on February 27 as part of the official program of his trip to Azerbaijan.

item.title: Pakistan declares 'open war' with Taliban as jets bomb Kabul
item.description: Pakistan launched strikes on the Afghan cities of Kabul and Kandahar in the early hours of Friday, according to Pakistani government officials, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Baku hosts official welcome ceremony for Prime Minister of Ethiopia
item.description: An official welcome ceremony was held in Baku for Prime Minister of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed Ali on February 27, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azeri Light gains nearly 2% amid global oil price increase
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude rose at Italy’s Port of Augusta, increasing by $1.32, or 1.85 percent, compared to the previous session to reach $72.78 per barrel on a CIF basis, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev, Prime Minister of Ethiopia hold one-on-one meeting
item.description: On February 27, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev had a one-on-one meeting with Prime Minister of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed Ali, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan boxers claim victories in Bulgaria
item.description: Strandja 2026 International Boxing Tournament is underway in Sofia, the capital of Bulgaria, AzerNEWS reports.
